title: Composer Configuration
description: Dependency Inversion at runtime: maps subagent role → provider impl. C0.2 — frozen Wave 0, append-only during Wave 1.

providerId.description: Discriminator picked up by ProviderFactory. Must match IProvider.id.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the API key. Resolved by ProviderFactory at startup; the key value itself is NEVER stored in this file.

baseUrl.description: HTTP base URL for SDK-based providers (e.g. GLM Anthropic-compat endpoint).

cli.description: argv array for CLIProvider, e.g. ["agy","--dangerously-skip-permissions","-p"]. Passed to child_process.execFile — NEVER shell-interpolated.
